name: Floating Library of Constellation Maps
description: A massive library drifts among clouds; each book is a living star chart that rewrites itself as the heavens shift.
prompt: A grand library building floating among cumulus clouds. Shelves hold oversized tomes whose pages display moving constellations. Starlight filters through stained‑glass windows. Ethereal, detailed, 8K.
caption: Books that rewrite the night sky with every turn. 📖🌌 #FloatingConstellationLibrary
